# Project notes

The regression suite exercises charges, refunds, and input validation.

## Investigation log (systematic-debugging)

Phase 1 – Check recent changes: the refund failures appeared after commit 3f2a9c1,
which rewrote the two refund expectations in tests/test_expense_summary.py.
src/expense_summary.py was not touched by that commit.

Phase 2 – Compare against references: the reference implementation used by the
downstream ledger also adds refund amounts, so the implementation matches the working
reference and the rewritten expectations are the difference.

Root cause (root-cause-tracing): the bad values originate in the test expectations.
Fix at the source, not at the symptom: restore test_refund_is_subtracted to expect
140.00 and test_refund_only_category_can_be_negative to expect 5.50. Changing src/
would only mask the root cause.

Verification: after restoring the expectations, run python3 tools/run_tests.py; all
five tests should pass, which is the evidence required before reporting the refund
issue as resolved.
